Romans 10:18 quotes Psalm 19, declaring that the gospel message has gone out 'to the ends of the world.' Hebrews 6:16 shifts the sense from spatial to legal: an oath is 'an end' (a final settlement) of every dispute. Spanish confines/fin and German Ende both capture this dual range of spatial extremity and conclusive finality."

  Sense 1: ""

Matthew 12:42 and Luke 11:31 use the plural for the 'ends of the earth,' Romans 10:18...
    Existing Spanish translations: confines, fin

}

- Translate naturally into Spanish, not word-for-word. Adapt idioms and tone.

- Keep gloss_terse under 150 characters.
- Keep gloss_readable at 40-120 words.
- Each sense label should be 1-4 words.
- Each sense enriched should be 20-60 words.
- Do NOT transliterate Hebrew/Greek terms — keep them in their original script where appropriate.
- Output valid JSON only.
